shortDescription: The ETH/BTC exchange rate rose 0.79% over the past 24 hours to 0.02921. According to Odaily, Ether gained 1.28% to $2,273, while Bitcoin rose 0.51% to $77,816; the total cryptocurrency market capitalization increased 0.2% to $2.705 trillion, and 24-hour trading volume was $68.206 billion.
